theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.θmat_tensor (c : ℂ) (X Y : Obj) :
θmat c (X.tensor Y) = kron (θmat c X) (θmat c Y) * βmat c Y X * βmat c X Y

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.expi_three {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (A B C : EndL L) (cAB : Commute A B) (cAC : Commute A C) (cBC : Commute B C) :
expi (A + B + (C + C)) = expi A * expi B * (expi C * expi C)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.βmat_βmat (c : ℂ) (X Y : Obj) :
βmat c Y X * βmat c X Y = expi (c • tsl (bL X Y) (bR X Y)) * expi (c • tsl (bL X Y) (bR X Y))

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.univ_tensor (X Y : Obj) :
Finset.univ = bL X Y ∪ bR X Y

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.θmat_unit (c : ℂ) :
θmat c Obj.unit = 1

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.θmat_natural (c : ℂ) {X Y : Obj} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
↑f * θmat c X = θmat c Y * ↑f

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.equivariant_θinv (c : ℂ) (X : Obj) :
Equivariant (θinv c X)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.equivariant_θmat (c : ℂ) (X : Obj) :
Equivariant (θmat c X)

def QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.θinv (c : ℂ) (X : Obj) :
EndL X.Leaves

def QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.θmat (c : ℂ) (X : Obj) :
EndL X.Leaves

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tsl_univ_comm_diag {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (ha : a.trace = 0) :
Commute (tsl Finset.univ Finset.univ) (diag L a)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.traceless_decomp (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (ha : a.trace = 0) :
a = a 0 1 • eS + a 1 0 • fS + a 0 0 • hS

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_add {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (S : Finset L) (a b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk S (a + b) = blk S a + blk S b

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_smul {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (S : Finset L) (r : ℂ) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk S (r • a) = r • blk S a

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.leafOp_smul {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (i : L) (r : ℂ) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
leafOp i (r • a) = r • leafOp i a

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tsl_union_self {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) :
tsl (S ∪ T) (S ∪ T) = tsl S S + tsl T T + (tsl S T + tsl S T)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tsl_union_right {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) (W : Finset L) :
tsl W (S ∪ T) = tsl W S + tsl W T

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tsl_union_left {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) (W : Finset L) :
tsl (S ∪ T) W = tsl S W + tsl T W

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tsl_self_comm_self {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) :
Commute (tsl S S) (tsl T T)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tsl_self_comm_tsl' {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) :
Commute (tsl T T) (tsl S T)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tsl_self_comm_tsl {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) :
Commute (tsl S S) (tsl S T)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tsl_self_comm_blk_disj {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) (b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
Commute (tsl S S) (blk T b)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tsl_self_comm {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (S : Finset L) :
Commute (tsl S S) (blk S eS) ∧ Commute (tsl S S) (blk S fS) ∧ Commute (tsl S S) (blk S hS)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_neg {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (S : Finset L) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk S (-a) = -blk S a

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_nsmul {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (S : Finset L) (n : ℕ) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk S (n • a) = n • blk S a

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.leafOp_add {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (i : L) (a b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
leafOp i (a + b) = leafOp i a + leafOp i b

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.sl2_hf :
hS * fS - fS * hS = -(2 • fS)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.sl2_he :
hS * eS - eS * hS = 2 • eS

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.sl2_ef :
eS * fS - fS * eS = hS

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.casimir_comm {R : Type u_1} [Ring R] [Algebra ℂ R] (E F H : R) (hEF : E * F - F * E = H) (hHE : H * E - E * H = 2 • E) (hHF : H * F - F * H = -(2 • F)) :
Commute (E * F + F * E + (1 / 2) • (H * H)) E ∧ Commute (E * F + F * E + (1 / 2) • (H * H)) F ∧ Commute (E * F + F * E + (1 / 2) • (H * H)) H

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_union {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk (S ∪ T) a = blk S a + blk T a

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_bracket {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (S : Finset L) (a b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk S a * blk S b - blk S b * blk S a = blk S (a * b - b * a)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_comm {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) (a b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
Commute (blk S a) (blk T b)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.leafOp_one {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (i : L) :
leafOp i 1 = 1

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.leafOp_sub {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (i : L) (a b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
leafOp i (a - b) = leafOp i a - leafOp i b

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.leafOp_comm {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {i j : L} (hij : i ≠ j) (a b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
Commute (leafOp i a) (leafOp j b)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.leafOp_mul_same {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (i : L) (a b : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
leafOp i a * leafOp i b = leafOp i (a * b)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.sum_update {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (i : L) (y : L → Fin 2) (F : (L → Fin 2) → ℂ) (hF : ∀ (z : L → Fin 2), (¬∀ (j : L), j ≠ i → y j = z j) → F z = 0) :
∑ z : L → Fin 2, F z = ∑ k : Fin 2, F (Function.update y i k)
